Two Factor Authentication¶

This guide explains how to enable two factor authentication for the user accounts.

Two factor authentication is a security feature that requires a user to enter a code from their mobile phone to log in to the system. The client comes with a built-in two factor authentication module which is available for use.

In order to enable two factor authentication for your account, please follow the steps below:

  1. Go to the accounts page by going the to the Accounts & Multifactor Authentication page (See the Account Links section).

  2. If you have not already added a email address to your account, please add one by clicking on the “Add Email” button.

  3. Click on the link titled Two-Factor Authentication.

  4. Click on the Activate button on the page that loads. You will be reprompted for your password.

  5. You will be asked to scan a QR code with the Google Authenticator app on your mobile phone.

  6. Enter the code generated by the app in the field provided.

  7. Click on the Activate button on the page that loads.

  8. You can then create backup codes by clicking on the “Create Backup Codes” button. Download these and store them in a secure location.

  9. Next time you log in, you will be asked to enter the code generated by the app in addition to your password.
